scientific_integrity: The 2-(28,12,11) design, bitangent-theta correspondence and Steiner complex labels are established inputs; the integral Smith factors and minimal reconstruction multiplier are the theorem under review. Two exact independent implementations reproduce the finite matrix calculations.
scientific_limitations: Abstract integral geometric incidence lattice over any field of characteristic different from two; no arithmetic Galois-module or specialization classification. Exact historical priority is not independently established. A general 1992 quasi-symmetric-design Smith study could contain an overlapping computation.
title: Integral Steiner reconstruction lattice of plane-quartic bitangents
